purpose: Verified 30-record batch 111 from the clean 361-record reference-dependent queue. Batch size was intentionally reduced below the 50-record ceiling because the remaining pool contains more deep spell inheritance, source tables, and creature/stat-block dependencies. These thirty records were selected for self-contained source mechanics or already-reviewed lineage and were individually source/digest checked.

spells/hidden-lodge-4702.name: Hidden Lodge
spells/hidden-lodge-4702.effectSummary: Functions as Leomund's secure shelter, but the lodge is perfectly camouflaged to resemble appropriate natural terrain and suppresses signs of habitation such as smoke, light, and sound. Beyond 30 feet it is indistinguishable from natural terrain; within 30 feet, a DC 30 Survival check can identify it as an artificial dwelling.
spells/hidden-lodge-4702.notes: Manually source-reviewed and digest-locked; batch 111 deliberately uses a smaller high-confidence set as the remaining queue becomes more dependency-heavy.

provenance.role: primary Spell Compendium catalog record and digest source

spells/ice-castle-1253.name: Ice Castle
spells/ice-castle-1253.effectSummary: Creates a large fortified castle of snow and ice with walls, towers, gates, battlements, a blue-ice central tower, and one extra tower per six caster levels, up to a 20-foot-per-level perimeter. You can place two icicle wards, ice-slick stair traps, and obscuring snow. On level ground it gains a 20-foot moat; on steep ground, a 20-foot-wide 50-foot-deep crevasse. Ordinary sections have 200 hp per 5 feet and hardness 0; blue ice has 300 hp and hardness 10. Above-freezing heat deals 1d6 damage per round, fire deals full damage, and sudden melting creates 10 minutes of steam fog. Focus: a 2,000 gp blue-ice castle model.
spells/ice-castle-1253.notes: Manually source-reviewed and digest-locked; batch 111 deliberately uses a smaller high-confidence set as the remaining queue becomes more dependency-heavy.

provenance.role: primary Frostburn catalog record and digest source

spells/ice-rift-1273.name: Ice Rift
spells/ice-rift-1273.effectSummary: For 1 round, violently fractures ice and snow terrain so creatures in the area cannot move or attack and spellcasters must make Concentration DC 20 + spell level. In ice caves it collapses roofs for 8d6 bludgeoning, Reflex DC 15 half, and burial. At glacier edges it creates a landslide with the same damage and pinning. On open glaciers it knocks creatures down and can drop them into fissures; on frozen water it can drop them into freezing water for 2d6 cold. Open fissures close at the end, potentially killing or trapping creatures still inside.
spells/ice-rift-1273.notes: Manually source-reviewed and digest-locked; batch 111 deliberately uses a smaller high-confidence set as the remaining queue becomes more dependency-heavy.

spells/improved-blink-3475.name: Improved Blink
spells/improved-blink-3475.effectSummary: Lets you consciously control blinking between the Material and Ethereal planes. Physical and individually targeted magical attacks against you normally have 50% miss chance, reduced when they can affect ethereal targets; you suffer no miss chance on your own attacks or spells. Area damage is halved unless it extends to the Ethereal Plane. You attack as invisible, take half falling damage, can ready a blink to automatically avoid one attack that cannot affect ethereal targets, move at three-quarters speed, can pass through solid objects with shunting damage if you stop inside one, and can see and attack ethereal creatures.
spells/improved-blink-3475.notes: Manually source-reviewed and digest-locked; batch 111 deliberately uses a smaller high-confidence set as the remaining queue becomes more dependency-heavy.

spells/ironwood-2826.name: Ironwood
spells/ironwood-2826.effectSummary: Transforms normal wood into ironwood: still natural wood for wood-affecting magic, but as strong, heavy, and fire-resistant as steel and unaffected by metal-only effects such as heat metal. With wood shape or Craft, it can form steel-equivalent wooden gear usable by druids. If you create only half the normal amount, a weapon, shield, or suit of armor made from it gains a +1 enhancement bonus. Material component: wood shaped like the intended item.

spells/magnetism-553.name: Magnetism

Secured objects can be torn free with a Strength check using the ray's +10. Material component: lodestone.

spells/reanimation-2037.effectSummary: Restores a willing creature dead up to 1 day per caster level to a half-living state for 1 day per caster level.
